title: At the table
subtitle: Serving and pairing Torrontés
objectives: Know how long to keep it

steps.title: Aromatic food
steps.body: Torrontés suits aromatic, lightly spiced food: Thai, Indian, Vietnamese dishes, ceviche, and Argentine empanadas from Salta, filled with spiced beef. Its floral perfume and freshness suit coriander, ginger and lemongrass. Avoid heavy, rich sauces.

steps.title: Service and age
steps.body: Serve at 7 to 10 degrees. Torrontés is best young, within one to two years, while its aromas are fresh. With age, it can turn bitter and lose its perfume.

steps.prompt: Which dish is a classic match for Torrontés in Salta?
steps.explanation: Salta's empanadas and Torrontés are a regional pairing.

steps.body: Torrontés is a good choice for sushi or Thai food at a restaurant, when you want something aromatic but dry.

steps.prompt: Which flavours in food suit Torrontés?

steps.title: What you learned
points: Torrontés suits empanadas, ceviche and Asian food
Drink it within one to two years
